title: NAF 22738
contents: Louis XIV's instructions to Feuquières discuss Sweden's military plans and the risk of sending a fleet into the Baltic.
status: 4/4 pages transcribed; 4/4 pages deciphered in part
fields: Plaintext in the margin or below

excerpt: **pouvoir reduire entierement les ennemis de la Suede par la force, que je crois important de profiter des dispositions où ils paroissent de s’accommoder avec cette Couronne,**
translation: to overcome Sweden’s enemies completely by force; I consider it important to take advantage of their apparent willingness to reach an accommodation with that Crown.
